title: AGENTIC USERNAME SUGGESTION AND MULTIMODAL GENDER DETECTION IN ONLINE PLATFORMS: INTRODUCING THE PNGT-26K DATASET

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigating the documented performance degradation of NLP systems on non-Western names by curating and analyzing a culturally representative dataset of Persian names and their English transliterations.
Evaluating orthographic patterns, name lengths, and character distributions across male and female names to build a more equitable and accurate multimodal gender detection framework.

Addressing the 'transliteration bottleneck' of non-Latin scripts by providing standardized one-to-many English mappings for Persian characters to improve information retrieval and NLP system fairness.
